description: Get the full record for one open tender notice: description, dates, buyer and end users, selection criteria, trade agreements, commodity codes, contact, attachments and links. Look it up by the reference_number or solicitation_number returned by search_tenders. A solicitation number shared by several notices returns all of them.

id.description: Reference number or solicitation number, exactly as shown in search results.

lang.description: Output language; "both" returns each text field in English and French.

max_description_chars.description: Cut the description to this many characters. Raise it when description_truncated is true and you need the rest.

name: get_tender
title: Get tender details
